About the jobDesign products people want to use in real life
Unreal Urban builds technology that brings people, communities and cities together. Our first flagship product, Falorin, is a live web and mobile platform for discovering, creating and joining real-world experiences.

We are looking for a hands-on Founding Product / UX Designer to make Falorin clearer, more useful and more delightful at every step—from first discovery to creating or joining an experience. You will help turn real user behaviour and community insight into simple, high-quality product experiences.

This is an early-stage, equity-based collaboration; there is no cash salary at this stage. Equity will be discussed transparently with strong candidates based on scope, commitment and contribution.

What you'll do

- Own end-to-end product and UX design for Falorin across web and mobile.

- Turn user research, feedback and behavioural data into flows, prototypes and polished interfaces.

- Simplify the critical journeys: discovery, onboarding, creation, joining and returning.

- Work directly with founders, engineering and growth to prioritise the highest-impact product improvements.

- Help establish a flexible design system that can support future Unreal Urban products.

What we're looking for

- Strong portfolio of product/UX work for consumer, marketplace, social or mobile products.

- Excellent user-flow, interaction and visual design judgement.

- Comfortable moving from problem framing and quick prototypes to implementation-ready detail.

- Practical fluency with Figma and close collaboration with developers.

- Curious about how digital products can improve real-world connection.

Why join
You will shape a live flagship product at an important early stage, with real ownership over what users see, feel and do. Your work on Falorin can become the design foundation for a broader Unreal Urban portfolio.

Job DescriptionAbout the Role
We're looking for a Product Designer  Design Systems to join our design systems team and help elevate the consistency, usability, and visual language of all our products. Design, document, and maintain reusable components, patterns, and tokens in Figma. Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation of design tokens and UI components Define and uphold visual and interaction standards that align with Fynd's brand and accessibility goals. 24 years of experience in product design with at least 12 years focused on design systems. Proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto-layout, variants, and tokens. Experience in B2B SaaS UX . Worked on B2B SaaS design systems. Excellent visual design skills with a keen eye for typography, spacing, and hierarchy. A systems thinker with an obsessive attention to detail and a love for documentation. Experience collaborating cross-functionally with engineering and design teams. Familiarity with accessibility principles (WCAG) and inclusive design practices. Familiarity with AI tools and usage of AI in day to day tasks is a must. Good to have
Prior experience maintaining or contributing to a cross-platform(multi brand) design system. Experience with motion design for micro-interactions. You have a good understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScriptWhy You'll Love Working at Fynd A growing design culture with ambitious, supportive teammates. Opportunity to work on a large-scale design system used across multiple industries, products and surfaces. Ownership, autonomy, and the ability to influence system strategy and evolution. Competitive compensation and wellness benefits A culture that values clarity, craft, care, and collaboration .

Job DescriptionDesigner, Content Production As one of the worlds leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco. Job Description Who we are With over $1.58 trillion of assets under management, Invesco is one of the worlds leading global investment management firms, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Spreading across 26 countries and with over 8400 dedicated employees, we are driven by trust and care. As one of the worlds leading asset managers, we are solely dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. If you're looking for challenging work, thoughtful colleagues, and a global employer with social values, explore your potential at Invesco. Your Team In support of Invescos position as a leading independent global investment management company which provides a comprehensive array of enduring investment solutions for retail, institutional and high net worth clients around the world, this position is responsible for executing marketing communications including high-level print and electronic production & multi-media support, while providing expert support in industry-specific programs, file management and work processes in support of the companys marketing/sales initiatives and regulatory requirements. Your Role Design and produce marketing collateral, brochures, infographics, forms, electronic corporate presentation materials and other digital and print communication materials, under minimal supervision Ensure all deliverables comply with brand guidelines, meet quality standards and production requirements through thorough self-review to ensure accuracy and consistency Manage multiple projects simultaneously, assess requirements, and deliver work within established timelines Take ownership of assigned projects from initiation through completion while meeting agreed timelines and stakeholder expectations Leverage AI-enabled productivity and design tools to improve efficiency, creativity, and turnaround times while maintaining quality standards. Follow diligent file management / organizes & archives files according to established departmental processes Become proficient in utilizing web-based job trafficking system (Aprimo) to manage all production tasks The Experience You Bring 2+ years of experience in graphic design, content production, or creative services supporting multiple projects in a fast-paced environment Strong understanding of graphic design principles, typography, layout, branding, print production, video editing and motion graphics creation Proficiency in Adobe CC tools, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat, Premier and After Effects Experience with video editing, motion graphics, and multimedia content development is a plus. Knowledge in producing/editing HTML5/CSS3 email templates / banners is added advantage Exposure to Adobe Firefly, Generative AI tools, and AI-powered video editing platforms will be a plus Skills/Other Personal Attributes Required: Ability to work independently and with the team; flexible to work on multiple projects and meet tight deadlines maintaining quality standards Ability to review/troubleshoot files and provide effective, thoughtful solutions to issues in a professional and productive manner Effectively communicate with a variety of individuals at all technical levels across our global network Team player  ability to communicate and work effectively as part of a team Open minded, flexible, and willing to listen to other opinions Strong organizational skills and detail oriented Academic requirements An Associate's degree in graphic design, visual communications or related field preferred. Two years of work experience in technical graphic design & content production/page layout/file management may be considered in lieu of educational requirements. Full Time / Part Time Full time Worker Type Employee Job Exempt (Yes / No) No Workplace Model At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office. Why Invesco In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each others identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by .

Job DescriptionJob Title: UI/UX Designer
Experience: 2 Years to 5 Years

Work Mode: Full-time (On-site)

Job Summary
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer with strong handson experience in designing intuitive digital experiences. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of usercentered design principles along with practical knowledge of image cleaning, visual enhancement, and basic video concepts to support modern digital product requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Design user-friendly and visually appealing interfaces for web and mobile applications
Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs using design tools
Ensure a seamless user experience through research, user flows, and usability best practices
Work closely with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality design solutions
Perform image cleaning, retouching, and optimization for digital assets
Support basic video editing or motion-related design requirements for product/marketing content
Maintain consistency in design systems, typography, color schemes, and branding guidelines
Conduct usability testing and iterate designs based on feedback
Stay updated with latest UI/UX trends, tools, and technologies

Required Skills & Qualifications

2 to 5 years of proven experience in UI/UX design
Strong portfolio showcasing UI/UX projects
Proficiency in tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator (or similar)
Hands-on experience in image editing / image cleaning (background removal, retouching, enhancement)
Basic understanding of video editing or motion graphics concepts (After Effects/Premiere Pro is a plus)
Strong understanding of user-centered design principles
Good communication and collaboration skills
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

Good to Have

Experience in design systems and component libraries
Knowledge of HTML/CSS basics
Familiarity with agile development environments
Understanding of branding and digital marketing design needs

About Us

At Sellergize, we build and offer a complete stack of Technology Products & Services to scale the customer's Affiliate marketing business.

Job Description

We are looking for UI / UX Designers to add life & excitement to our product, and yet keep it simple to operate. We have planned some really innovative features.

Your role in this project will be to create interactive designs and give a magical experience to all our visitors in each flow. These designs will not be limited to just the website & app, but also stretch into integrations with various bots and third-party tools.

This role is ideal for young designers who want to work on a high-growth B2C project and would love to be part of product management of a high-traffic app (we're targeting 50M users by the end of this year alone).

You will be working with the product team to finalise the features, then create multiple design options, and also work with the front-end developers to make sure the designs are correctly implemented. You will also be responsible for identifying UX issues in the live applications from time to time and give smart solutions.

You will also be responsible for approval of graphic designs for use on our Website, Apps, Email newsletters, App notifications, Social Media, etc.

Key Responsibilities:

-
Designing end-to-end experiences across iOS, Android, and web  from early concepts to production-ready specs.
-
Collaborating closely with product managers and engineers to understand goals, surface edge cases, and ship great work together.
- Owning the visual craft  crafting high-fidelity UI that's clean, consistent, and meticulously detailed in every state and interaction.
- Building and maintaining our design system in Figma  components, tokens, variants, documentation, and everything in between.
- Creating and managing Figma prototypes that communicate interaction flows clearly to stakeholders and developers.
- Conducting user research and usability testing to validate ideas, uncover pain points, and continuously raise the quality bar.
- Keeping Figma files clean and well-organized with structured naming, proper component usage, and scalable file management.
- Incorporating AI-aware design thinking  staying current on how AI features and interaction patterns show up in modern product experiences.
- Iterating based on feedback and data  you treat your designs as living work, not final deliverables.

Requirements

- 25 years of experience in UI/UX design, with a portfolio that demonstrates solid visual craft, design thinking, and real collaboration.

- Exceptional attention to detail  you notice when something is off by 2px, and it bothers you enough to fix it.

- Strong visual design skills  typography, layout, colour, spacing, and iconography are things you actively care about and do well.

- Deep expertise in Figma  prototyping, auto-layout, components, variants, variables, and design system management.

- Experience designing for iOS and Android  you understand platform conventions, gesture patterns, and mobile-first thinking.

- Experience creating and maintaining a Figma design system  not just using one, but building and owning one.

- Track record of working in fast-paced teams and collaborating actively with product and engineering throughout the design and build process.

- Basic understanding of AI and its role in product design  familiarity with AI interaction patterns and how to design for intelligent features.

- Excellent communication skills  you can articulate your design decisions clearly to engineers, PMs, and leadership alike.

- A portfolio is required  it should show your visual craft, your UX process, and evidence of collaboration with product and engineering teams.

NICE TO HAVE

- Prior experience designing for high-traffic B2C applications.

- Familiarity with motion design and micro-interactions.

- Experience working on smart device or IoT interfaces.

- Exposure to front-end code (HTML/CSS)  enough to have productive conversations with engineers.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Product Designer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing user-centric, visually appealing, and functional products. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the user experience and interface while ensuring alignment with business objectives.

RequirementsDesign Conceptualization Create wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to communicate and test design concepts.

Collaborate with stakeholders to iterate on design solutions based on feedback and data.

Copywriting Write clear, engaging, and user-focused copy that complements the design and guides users effectively.

Ensure consistency and alignment with the products tone and brand voice.

Data-Driven Design Use analytics and user data to refine user flows and optimize the product experience.

Continuously evaluate product performance and make informed design adjustments.

UX/UI Design Design intuitive and visually compelling user interfaces that align with business goals.

Map out seamless user flows that improve engagement and satisfaction.

Animation & Motion Create immersive animations and motion graphics that amplify the product experience

Collaboration Partner with product managers to align on requirements and goals.

Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs and copy.

Continuous Improvement Incorporate feedback from testing and data analysis to refine designs and user flows.

Stay informed on design trends and best practices to bring fresh ideas to the team.
Requirements

3+ years of proven experience in UX/UI, motion & product design.

Proficiency in design tools like Figma.

Strong understanding of user-centered design principles.

Ability to create wireframes, prototypes, and detailed design specifications.

Excellent communication and teamwork skills to work with cross-functional teams.

Ability to present and justify design decisions to stakeholders.

Analytical mindset with a focus on user needs and business goals.

Creative problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

We are looking for a person who can adapt to the latest AI technologies, such as ChatGPT, and leverage them to enhance their productivity and efficiency.
BenefitsMentorship: Work next to some of the best engineers and designers.

Freedom: An environment where you get to practice your craft. No micromanagement.

Growth: A tailor-made program to help you achieve your career goals.

A voice that is heard: We don't claim to know the best way of doing things. We like to listen to ideas from our team. .

Job DescriptionJob Overview

We are seeking a talented and creative Graphic Designer to join our dynamic team at our Hyderabad office. As a mid-level position, the ideal candidate will have up to 5 years of experience in the field. This is a full-time opportunity for professionals passionate about visual design, looking to make a significant impact in human resources and recruitment services.

Qualifications and Skills

Proficient in design systems, with the ability to maintain cohesive visual languages across products.
Solid experience in web design, focusing on user experience and accessibility for diverse audiences.
Skilled in creating detailed and engaging illustrations that enhance brand identity and storytelling.
Expertise in visual communication, translating complex ideas into clear, appealing graphics
Strong understanding of branding principles, ensuring design consistency across all visual media
Proficient in UI/UX design, with a strong focus on user-centered design principles
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to align design goals with business objectives.
Excellent time management skills, capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Roles and Responsibilities

Develop and refine creative design solutions in collaboration with marketing and product teams.
Produce high-quality digital assets across various platforms, ensuring consistency and excellence.
Conduct research to understand market trends and user preferences, incorporating insights into designs.
Maintain and evolve design systems, contributing to the overall visual identity of the company.
Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are feasible and accurately implemented.
Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute with innovative ideas and creative solutions.
Present design concepts to stakeholders, incorporating feedback to enhance the final product.
Ensure all designs comply with legal standards and company policies regarding brand representation. .

Graphic Designer Jobs in Hyderabad FAQ's- How can I find a graphic designing job in Hyderabad?
Candidates generally look for better job opportunities in Hyderabad since the city offers giant IT tycoons and other industries. Designers in the city are in demand considering all Industries present. People can search for vacancies by signing in different job portals and registering with premium consultancies. Moreover, applying on the company's website and contacting recruiters via emails can help find the job easier.

- Is relocating to Hyderabad a good option?
Home to upscale restaurants and shops, Hyderabad is the city which offers a positive and suitable environment for candidates who migrate from other cities. The growth opportunities are high with attractive multinational corporates. People generally locate to Hyderabad because it is way cheaper than other metro cities and even convenient to afford in every aspect.

- How is the work environment in Hyderabad?
Like other prospective cities in India, Hyderabad offers fixed working time from 9 to 6 hours in a day along with flexible night shift options in some premium companies. The town is safe for women and offers impressive climate compared to northern Indian cities.

- what is the salary range of a graphic designer?
The salary for a graphic designer in India initially starts from INR 2 to 3 lakh per annum. if the candidate is well experienced, it often extends between INR 4 lakh to 6 Lakh per annum. Besides, It depends upon your work skills if you are a proficient designer, then it can range more than the average salary.

Job DescriptionAbout the Role

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Motion Graphics Designer & Animator to bring our mobile app and brand to life through engaging, high-quality animations. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of motion design, UI animations, storytelling, and visual aesthetics, with the ability to create smooth, modern, and premium animations for both the app and social media.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and create high-quality 2D motion graphics and animations.
* Create engaging animations for the mobile app, including:
* Onboarding screens
* Splash screens
* UI transitions
* Micro-interactions
* Loading animations
* Feature demonstrations
* In-app promotional animations
* Produce promotional videos and animated content for social media.
* Collaborate with the UI/UX and product team to create seamless user experiences.
* Maintain consistency with the apps branding and design language.
* Optimize animations for mobile performance without compromising quality.
* Deliver assets in multiple formats suitable for Android, iOS, and marketing platforms.
* Revise designs based on feedback and meet project deadlines.

Requirements

* Minimum 3 years of experience in Motion Graphics and Animation.
* Strong portfolio showcasing motion graphics, UI animations, and promotional videos.
* Proficiency in:
* Adobe After Effects
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Figma
* Lottie (Bodymovin)
* Knowledge of animation principles, timing, easing, and storytelling.
* Experience creating animations for mobile applications.
* Understanding of responsive design and mobile UI/UX.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to delivering polished, qualified work.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with Rive animations.
* Basic knowledge of Blender or Cinema 4D.
* Experience creating app explainer videos.
* Understanding of branding and visual identity.
* Familiarity with exporting assets for developers (JSON/Lottie, GIF, MP4, SVG).

What Were Looking For

* A creative thinker with a modern design sense.
* Someone who can transform ideas into visually engaging animations.
* Passion for creating premium, clean, and user-friendly experiences.
* Ability to take ownership of projects and suggest creative improvements.
* Someone who stays updated with the latest animation and design trends.

Portfolio Requirement

Applicants must submit a portfolio showcasing:

* Motion graphics projects
* Mobile app animations
* UI micro-interactions
* Promotional or advertisement videos
* Social media animations

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. .

Job DescriptionSummary:
As a Graphic Designer at Appizion Consulting & Solutions, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the visual identity and creative output of our client-facing projects across diverse industries. This entry-level position is ideal for a creative, detail-oriented individual eager to grow within a dynamic consulting environment. You will collaborate closely with marketing, strategy, and design teams to develop compelling visual content that enhances brand messaging, supports client presentations, and drives engagement. From concept to execution, your work will contribute directly to the success of high-impact consulting deliverables, including pitch decks, infographics, reports, digital assets, and social media content. This role offers a unique prospect to build a solid foundation in skilled design while working on real-world business challenges in a fast-paced, innovative setting.

Responsibilities:
Design visually engaging and brand-consistent graphics for client presentations, reports, proposals, and digital platforms.
Create infographics, charts, diagrams, and data visualizations that simplify complex information for clarity and impact.
Collaborate with consultants and project managers to understand business objectives and translate them into compelling visual narratives.
Maintain and update brand guidelines, templates, and design libraries to ensure consistency across all deliverables.
Produce high-quality digital assets for web, social media, email campaigns, and print materials.
Participate in creative brainstorming sessions and provide design input during project planning stages.
Stay updated on design trends, tools, and best practices to continuously improve design quality and efficiency.
Manage multiple projects with competing deadlines, ensuring timely delivery without compromising on quality.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
Proficiency in industry-standard design t .

Graphic Designer Jobs in Hyderabad FAQ's- How can I find a graphic designing job in Hyderabad?
Candidates generally look for better job opportunities in Hyderabad since the city offers giant IT tycoons and other industries. Designers in the city are in demand considering all Industries present. People can search for vacancies by signing in different job portals and registering with premium consultancies. Moreover, applying on the company's website and contacting recruiters via emails can help find the job easier.

- Is relocating to Hyderabad a good option?
Home to upscale restaurants and shops, Hyderabad is the city which offers a positive and suitable environment for candidates who migrate from other cities. The growth opportunities are high with attractive multinational corporates. People generally locate to Hyderabad because it is way cheaper than other metro cities and even convenient to afford in every aspect.

- How is the work environment in Hyderabad?
Like other prospective cities in India, Hyderabad offers fixed working time from 9 to 6 hours in a day along with flexible night shift options in some premium companies. The town is safe for women and offers impressive climate compared to northern Indian cities.

- what is the salary range of a graphic designer?
The salary for a graphic designer in India initially starts from INR 2 to 3 lakh per annum. if the candidate is well experienced, it often extends between INR 4 lakh to 6 Lakh per annum. Besides, It depends upon your work skills if you are a proficient designer, then it can range more than the average salary.

About Pragmatyc

Pragmatyc is a software delivery company partnering with clients across industries — from smart building and smart city platforms to enterprise SaaS products — to design and ship reliable, user-centric digital solutions. We work closely with cross-functional delivery teams to turn complex business requirements into intuitive, well-engineered products.

Role Summary

We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can translate business and user requirements into clean, intuitive, and visually compelling digital experiences. You will work closely with delivery managers, product owners, and engineering teams across multiple concurrent client and internal projects — covering web apps, mobile apps, and enterprise dashboards — taking designs from early wireframes through to polished, developer-ready UI.

Key Responsibilities

- Translate requirements, user stories, and stakeholder input into wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity UI designs.

- Design responsive web and mobile interfaces that are consistent, accessible, and aligned with brand guidelines.

- Build and maintain design systems / component libraries to ensure consistency across products and projects.

- Create interactive prototypes to communicate design intent and validate flows before development.

- Collaborate with delivery managers and developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately.

- Conduct usability reviews and incorporate feedback from stakeholders, clients, and end users.

- Work across multiple concurrent projects, balancing client-specific branding with reusable design patterns.

- Prepare client-facing design assets and presentations that clearly communicate design rationale.

- Stay current with UI/UX trends, accessibility standards, and platform-specific design guidelines (Material, iOS HIG, etc.).

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 2–5 years of professional experience in UI/UX design for web and/or mobile products.

- Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design process: research, wireframing, prototyping, and final UI.

- Proficiency in Figma (required); familiarity with Adobe XD or Sketch is a plus.

- Solid understanding of responsive design, design systems, and accessibility (WCAG) principles.

- Ability to create and maintain component libraries and design tokens.

- Working knowledge of user research and usability testing methods.

- Strong communication skills to present and defend design decisions to clients and internal stakeholders.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-project delivery environment with shifting priorities.

Good to Have

- Experience designing for enterprise, B2B, or SaaS platforms.

- Basic understanding of front-end constraints (HTML/CSS) to design realistic, implementable UI.

- Exposure to design collaboration tools such as Zeplin, Storybook, or similar handoff tools.

- Experience working with Agile delivery teams and tools like Jira/Zoho Sprints.

What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on diverse, high-impact projects across industries and geographies.

- A collaborative team culture with direct exposure to clients and end-to-end product delivery.

- Room to shape design processes and systems as the design function scales.

- Competitive compensation aligned with experience and market standards.
